technical_quality: Adequate: good inspiration, no significant rotation, adequate penetration; L marker present at image upper right confirming conventional orientation. Costophrenic angles and upper abdomen included.

devices.type: Tunneled catheter with inverted-U loop (appearance most consistent with a peritoneovenous shunt or long tunneled central venous catheter)
devices.location: Loop at the patient's right supraclavicular / medial clavicular region; venous limb descends along the right mediastinal border (SVC course) to about the right atrial level; subcutaneous limb runs down the right anterior chest wall, crosses below the right hemidiaphragm into the right upper abdomen and continues off the inferior edge of the film

abnormalities.finding: Small pleural effusion: blunting of the costophrenic angle with a lateral meniscus and partial obscuration of the hemidiaphragm
Hazy basal opacity adjacent to the effusion, likely passive/basal atelectasis
Multiple small round calcific densities in the soft tissues of the neck, supraclavicular fossae, shoulders and axillae (soft-tissue calcification vs calcified lymph nodes)

description_zh: 胸部正面 (PA) X 光片，吸氣良好、無明顯旋轉。左側肋膈角變鈍並可見外側半月形液面，左側橫膈輪廓部分模糊，合併左下肺野淡霧狀陰影，符合少量左側肋膜積液併鄰近肺底塌陷；右側肋膈角銳利，右側橫膈清楚。右側可見一條皮下隧道式導管，於右鎖骨上/內側形成倒 U 形環，一肢沿右縱膈邊緣（上腔靜脈路徑）下行至約右心房高度，另一肢沿右前胸壁向下越過橫膈進入右上腹並延伸至片外，外觀較符合腹腔靜脈分流管或長隧道式中心靜脈導管；未見胸管或肋膜引流管。另於雙側頸部、鎖骨上及腋窩軟組織可見多發小圓形鈣化影，心影大小正常。
